title: On the Spectral Region of n-Cycle Stochastic Matrices
summary: For every $n\geq3$, we determine the union of the spectra of row-stochastic matrices supported on a directed $n$-cycle with self-loops and strictly positive cycle edges. These matrices describe progression through cyclic stages with geometric waiting times, and also arise by uniformization of unidirectional continuous-time reaction cycles. For the latter, the classification determines the minimum transition-rate bound required to realize a prescribed nonreal eigenvalue and provides rates attaining that bound.
